displayName: Hispanic & Latin American Nonprofit Grant Finder
summary: Matches a nonprofit's mission, location, sector, budget, and size against grant-making foundations and open federal grant opportunities, prioritizing funders/programs with a track record supporting Hispanic-serving organizations. Serves both US-based orgs and orgs based in Latin America (surfacing US-origin funding that reaches the latter, since there's no in-country/local funding database wired up).

inputs.name: org_mission
inputs.description: Short description of the organization's mission and programs

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: City/state (US) or country/city (Latin America) the org operates in or serves — determines whether US-domestic or LatAm funding sources apply

inputs.name: sector
inputs.description: e.g. education, health, arts, workforce development, immigration services

inputs.name: nonprofit_size
inputs.description: e.g. grassroots/volunteer-run, small (1-10 staff), mid-size (10-50 staff), large (50+ staff)

skills.output: A ranked table of 5-10 grant matches (private foundation and/or federal): type, funder/agency name, description, eligibility, typical grant size, and application deadline. Optionally followed by a Census-backed community-need context section.

dataSources.name: IRS Form 990 filings (via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer API)
dataSources.role: primary — private foundations, no API key required

dataSources.name: grants-gov MCP server (wraps the real Simpler Grants API)
dataSources.role: primary — open federal grant opportunities; requires a self-hosted server, see grant-finder-hispanic-server/README.md

dataSources.name: Census Bureau American Community Survey (ACS)
dataSources.role: optional — Hispanic/Latino population share and poverty rate for the org's city/county, to support the grant narrative; requires each installer's own free API key

dataSources.name: Claude web search
dataSources.role: fallback for current deadlines, newly announced grant cycles, and for federal opportunities if the grants-gov MCP server is unreachable
